typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	tblOpicsTradeReversalStaging_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		BR as string,
		DEALNO as string,
		SEQ as string,
		PRODUCT as string,
		PRODTYPE as string,
		CMNE as string,
		INPUTDATE as timestamp,
		CCY as string,
		CCYAMT as decimal(19,4),
		TRAD as string,
		PORT as string,
		COST as string,
		VOPER as string,
		REVDATE as timestamp,
		VERDATE as timestamp,
		REVREASON as string,
		REVTEXT as string,
		GROUPNAME as string,
		IOPER as string,
		VDATE as timestamp,
		DEALSRCE as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> OpicsPlusReversalTradesDLDT	source(output(
		BR as string,
		DEALNO as string,
		SEQ as string,
		PRODTYPE as string,
		CMNE as string,
		INPUTDATE as timestamp,
		CCY as string,
		CCYAMT as decimal(19,4),
		TRAD as string,
		PORT as string,
		COST as string,
		VOPER as string,
		REVDATE as timestamp,
		VERDATE as timestamp,
		REVREASON as string,
		REVTEXT as string,
		GROUPNAME as string,
		IOPER as string,
		VDATE as timestamp,
		PRODCODE as string,
		DEALSRCE as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> OpicsPlusReversalTradesFXDH	source(output(
		dealno as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> LookupLKPTABLE
OpicsPlusReversalTradesDLDT derive({Copy of SEQ} = SEQ,
		{Copy of PRODTYPE} = PRODTYPE,
		{Copy of VOPER} = VOPER,
		{Copy of IOPER} = IOPER,
		{Copy of BR} = BR,
		{Copy of DEALSRCE} = DEALSRCE,
		{Copy of PORT} = PORT,
		{Copy of CMNE} = CMNE,
		{Copy of COST} = COST,
		{Copy of PRODUCT} = PRODUCT,
		{Copy of TRAD} = TRAD,
		{Copy of REVREASON} = REVREASON,
		{Copy of DEALNO} = DEALNO,
		{Copy of GROUPNAME} = GROUPNAME,
		{Copy of REVTEXT} = REVTEXT,
		{Copy of CCY} = CCY) ~> Convertdatatypes
OpicsPlusReversalTradesFXDH derive({Copy of PRODCODE} = PRODCODE,
		{Copy of CCY} = CCY,
		{Copy of VOPER} = VOPER,
		{Copy of COST} = COST,
		{Copy of DEALNO} = DEALNO,
		{Copy of PORT} = PORT,
		{Copy of CMNE} = CMNE,
		{Copy of SEQ} = SEQ,
		{Copy of REVTEXT} = REVTEXT,
		{Copy of PRODTYPE} = PRODTYPE,
		{Copy of BR} = BR,
		{Copy of IOPER} = IOPER,
		{Copy of DEALSRCE} = DEALSRCE,
		{Copy of REVREASON} = REVREASON,
		{Copy of TRAD} = TRAD,
		{Copy of GROUPNAME} = GROUPNAME) ~> Convertdatatypes0
Convertdatatypes derive(Load_date = toString((currentTimestamp()))) ~> DerivedColumn1
Convertdatatypes0 derive(Load_date = toString((currentTimestamp()))) ~> DerivedColumn11
DerivedColumn11,DerivedColumn1 union(byName: true) ~> UnionAll
UnionAll,LookupLKPTABLE lookup({Copy of DEALNO} == LookupLKPTABLE@dealno,
	multiple: false,
	pickup: 'any',
	broadcast: 'none')~> Lookup
Lookup filter(!isMatch()) ~> Lookup0
Lookup0 sink(input(
		PRODTYPE as string,
		CCYAMT as integer,
		PORT as string,
		INPUTDATE as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		VOPER as string,
		DEALSRC as string,
		TRAD as string,
		REVDATE as string,
		VERDATE as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		REVREASON as string,
		BR as string,
		REVTEXT as string,
		COST as string,
		GROUPNAME as string,
		PRODUCT as string,
		CCY as string,
		DEALNO as string,
		LOADDATE as string,
		CMNE as string,
		SEQ as string,
		IOPER as string,
		VDATE as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy'
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		PRODTYPE = {Copy of PRODTYPE},
		CCYAMT,
		PORT = {Copy of PORT},
		INPUTDATE,
		VOPER = {Copy of VOPER},
		DEALSRC = {Copy of DEALSRCE},
		TRAD = {Copy of TRAD},
		REVDATE,
		VERDATE,
		REVREASON = {Copy of REVREASON},
		BR = {Copy of BR},
		REVTEXT = {Copy of REVTEXT},
		COST = {Copy of COST},
		GROUPNAME = {Copy of GROUPNAME},
		PRODUCT = {Copy of PRODUCT},
		CCY = {Copy of CCY},
		DEALNO = {Copy of DEALNO},
		LOADDATE = Load_date,
		CMNE = {Copy of CMNE},
		SEQ = {Copy of SEQ},
		IOPER = {Copy of IOPER},
		VDATE),
	partitionFileNames:[($tblOpicsTradeReversalStaging_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> tblOpicsTradeReversalStaging
